d:
Vaibhav suryavanshi ko kyon mili bihar ki kaman! aakhir kyon saunpi gaee itni bari jimmedari?
Bhartiy kriket ke ubharte sitare vaibhav suryavanshi ko bihar ki kaptani ki jimmedari milne ke bad kriket jagat men charchaen tej ho gaee hain. kya unki kaptani ka asar unke ballebaji phorm par dekhne ko milega?
Saiyad mushtak ali trophi (SMAT) 2026 men vaibhav suryavanshi se bihar ko kaphi ummiden hongi. kya vah kaptani ke sath-sath apne balle se bhi dhamal macha paenge? kya is naee jimmedari ke bad unke pradarshan men badlav aaega?
